title: The Science of Rainbows
script:
Rainbows are nature's most beautiful optical illusion. [Visual: rainbow sky colorful] [Transition: fade]
It all starts with sunlight. White light contains every color. [Visual: prism light spectrum refraction] [Transition: slide]
When sunlight hits a raindrop, it bends and reflects inside. [Visual: raindrop macro water droplet refraction] [Transition: slide]
Each color bends differently — red least, violet most. This is dispersion. [Visual: color spectrum visible light wavelength] [Transition: slide]
The result is the stunning arc we call a rainbow. [Visual: double rainbow full rainbow arc landscape] [Transition: fade]
